h6: Succulent, juicy chicken infused with aromatic Italian herbs, garlic, and olive oil, delivering a rich, comforting flavor that feels like authentic homemade Italian cuisine—perfect for a cozy dinner or elegant fine dining experience.
p: IngredientsChicken breasts or thighs, Olive oil, Garlic (minced), Fresh rosemary & thyme, Dried oregano, Cherry tomatoes, Spinach, Cream, Salt & pepper, Parmesan cheese

1. Season the Chicken Rub chicken with salt, pepper, oregano, and fresh herbs.2. Sear to PerfectionHeat olive oil in a pan and cook chicken until golden on both sides. Remove and set aside.3. Build the Flavor Base In the same pan, sauté garlic until fragrant, then add cherry tomatoes.4. Create the Sauce Add cream and stir gently. Toss in spinach and let it wilt.5. Bring It Together Return chicken to the pan and simmer for a few minutes until fully cooked.6. Finish & Serve Sprinkle Parmesan on top and serve warm.
